scripts.build: pnpm run build -w packages/markdown-to-jira-markup; npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently --names 'back,front,shared' 'pnpm run dev -w packages/backend' 'pnpm run dev -w packages/frontend' 'pnpm run dev -w packages/shared'
scripts.test: pnpm run test --workspaces && echo 'All tests passed.'
